# Draft:Amped revolution

Amped Revolution is an Indian hard rock band formed in Bengaluru in 2024. The group consists of Surya Pramod (electric guitar), Elakkiyan V (piano), Akshath R (acoustic guitar), and Aditya Artal (drums). Known for their energetic sound blending hard rock and punk influences, the band debuted with the single "Red Reality," featuring guest vocalist Keerthi V. Despite being new to the scene, Amped Revolution quickly earned a local following with their authentic live performances and raw musical energy.
History
Amped Revolution was founded in early 2024 by a group of young musicians from Bengaluru, united by their shared passion for high-energy rock music. Their debut single, "Red Reality," was released on June 26, 2024, featuring Keerthi V on vocals.
The band's first live performance took place on December 31, 2024, during a private New Year's Eve party at an apartment in Bengaluru. The intimate setting allowed the group to connect directly with the audience, showcasing their raw and energetic live style.
Musical style and influences
Amped Revolution’s music blends elements of punk rock's intensity with the melodic frameworks of hard rock. Their style is characterized by powerful electric guitar riffs, acoustic guitar harmonies, dynamic piano melodies, and hard-hitting drums. Lyrically, their work often explores themes of resilience, self-expression, and confronting reality. They cite influences from classic rock, punk anthems, and contemporary alternative sounds.
Band members
* Surya Pramod – Electric guitar (2024–present)
* Elakkiyan V – Piano (2024–present)
* Akshath R – Acoustic guitar (2024–present)
* Aditya Artal – Drums (2024–present)
Featured collaborators
* Keerthi V – Vocals (featured on "Red Reality" in 2024)
Discography
Singles
* "Red Reality" (feat. Keerthi V) (2024)
Live performances
* December 31, 2024: Performed at a private New Year's Eve party in Bengaluru, India.
Reception
Although early in their career, Amped Revolution’s debut single was praised for its high energy and authentic punk rock influences. Their grassroots live performance approach has helped them build an initial fanbase among rock music enthusiasts in Bengaluru.
